corridor.offset_definition: Delay J1 cycle start relative to J0; phase position=(simulation time-offset) mod cycle

protocol.selection: Among fully processed and integrity-passing offset cases minimize equal-seed mean timeLoss; freeze then validate unseen seeds
limitations: Protected origin turns plus exclusive pedestrians are a simplified research layout, not an optimized field signal plan.
Two straight-only intersections and fixed-speed pedestrians; no external network calibration.
Boundary occupancy indicates a stopped group near the observation boundary. It alone does not establish spillback.
Shorter connecting road also changes travel time and progression; the storage comparison is not a pure isolated storage experiment.

frozen.criterion: Among fully processed and integrity-passing offset cases minimize equal-seed mean timeLoss; freeze then validate unseen seeds

validation_records.scope: Scheduled-departure observation cohort; time means only completed vehicles. Edge series sampled every 5 s; includes warmup/drain with observation flag.
validation_records.queue_definition: Longest contiguous group with speed<0.1m/s for >1s and bumper gap<=10m, maximum across lanes. Boundary flag is observed truncation risk, not proof of spillback.
